probe_error.error: Need two or three support specifications; never truncate

seed_audit.reason: The requested readout is not semantically sound. It treats one support failure as evidence that the corresponding requested feature is absent, and both failures as proof of no progress. But n1 and n2 only assess visible evidence under their criteria; a failure may not establish that the image has not been transformed in the requested way. The readout therefore overstates negative evidence and can return absent or partial without sufficient support. It also requires both supports to pass for completion, although their criteria do not establish that the whole image was converted into a chalk drawing. The program needs evidence that supports the requested extent, not merely chalk-like treatment and drawing form in isolation.
